record.question:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct about the rules relating to dismissal, removal and suspension.
I. Where departmental proceedings against a Government servant under suspension ends with the imposition of a minor penalty, full pay and allowances shall be paid to the Government servant for the period of suspension.
II. Where a Government servant under suspension dies before the disciplinary proceedings are concluded, it is not necessary to treat the period between the date of suspension and the date of death as duty, rather it depends on the evidence(s) adduced so far in the inquiry. The decision of the disciplinary authority shall be final.
III. Payment made to a Government servant shall be subject to the production of non-employment certificate.
record.explanation: Only statements 1 and 3 about dismissal/removal/suspension are correct.
